title: Trend Radar
subtitle: What is trending and making news in your market, ready to become content
intro: This page gathers, around the clock, what is trending and making news in Premium Pro Contractors's world. Each card comes with an angle ready to turn into a Reel. Approve the ones you want to produce, dismiss the ones that do not fit, and leave a comment anytime. It updates on its own.

voice.quem: Premium Pro Contractors, a licensed and insured premium general contractor serving Peabody and the North Shore of Massachusetts with home remodeling, painting and carpentry.
voice.eixo_viral: Turn everyday remodeling questions and jaw-dropping before-and-afters into content that makes North Shore homeowners feel confident, inspired, and ready to request a quote from a contractor they can trust.
voice.tom: Technical authority that also inspires: confident, clear and honest, like a master builder who explains the why behind every decision, never salesy, always adding real value to the homeowner.
voice.gancho_formula: Start with a bold claim, a costly mistake or a surprising number, then promise the answer inside (curiosity gap + real stakes for the homeowner).
voice.gancho_default: THE #1 REMODELING MISTAKE HOMEOWNERS MAKE (AND HOW TO AVOID IT)
voice.alvo_default: North Shore MA homeowners planning a remodel

alvo.remodel: homeowners planning a kitchen or bathroom remodel
alvo.buyers: homeowners who just bought and want to renovate
alvo.investors: property owners looking to boost home value before selling

voice.angulo_corpo: Break the topic into clear, technical-but-simple points a homeowner actually understands: what it costs, what it takes, what to avoid, and the payoff, always framed around their home and their money.
voice.angulo_corpo_video: Show the transformation and the process: fast before-and-afters, close-ups of the craftsmanship, and one clear tip on screen per beat so the value lands even on mute.
voice.angulo_fecho: Close with a confident, low-pressure invitation to get a free estimate from a licensed and insured local team that treats the home like their own.
